description: Implement desktop sidebar multi-select distinct fill, 1.5pt EL_S_FOCUSED focus ring, quiet receding inactive titles (0.72 ink opacity), and Cmd+Z undo toast when composer is empty (#14029).

steps.send: Implement desktop sidebar polish (#14029) across `components/app/nav.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/page/layout/sidebar.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/page/editor.coax`, and `apps/openagents-desktop/page/checks/sidebar-groups-checks.coax`: 1) Add `selected: bool` to `AppSideRow` and pass `selected = sel` in `cp_side_chat_row` (keeping `EL_S_CURRENT` exclusively for the active chat), rendering multi-selected rows with a distinct tinted accent pill + border instead of the `EL_S_CURRENT` fill. 2) Paint a `1.5f32` focus ring on `EL_S_FOCUSED` sidebar cards without increasing card height. 3) Quietly recede already-read/inactive card titles (0.72 ink opacity, brightening on hover). 4) Wire `Cmd+Z` in `apps/openagents-desktop/page/editor.coax` to trigger the active sidebar Undo toast (`CP_SB_UNDO_ACT`) when no overlay/settings is open and the composer is empty. 5) Add checks in `sidebar-groups-checks.coax` and verify with `coax/bin/coax test components/app/nav.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only sidebar && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/app-v1.coax --library`.

graders.run: grep -q 'selected: bool' components/app/nav.coax && grep -q 'EL_S_FOCUSED' components/app/nav.coax && grep -q '0.72f32' components/app/nav.coax && grep -q 'CP_SB_UNDO_ACT' apps/openagents-desktop/page/editor.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/app/nav.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only sidebar && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/app-v1.coax --library
